source.text: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ לְדָ֫וִ֥דאָ֘מַ֤ר נָבָ֣ל בְּ֭לִבּוֹ אֵ֣ין אֱלֹהִ֑ים הִֽשְׁחִ֗יתוּ הִֽתְעִ֥יבוּ עֲלִילָ֗ה אֵ֣ין עֹֽשֵׂה־טֽוֹב׃

records.literal_gloss: For the director. Of David. Says [the] fool in his heart, There is no God. They have acted corruptly, they have done abominably [in] deed; there is none who does good.

en.L: For the director. Of David. The fool says in his heart, "There is no God." They have acted corruptly, they have done abominable deeds; there is none who does good.
en.B: For the music director. Of David. Fools tell themselves, "There is no God." They are rotten through and through; what they do is detestable. Not one of them does good.
en.R: For the leader of the music. By David. Foolish people think, "There is no God." They are evil, and they do terrible things. None of them does what is good.

fr.L: Au chef de chœur. De David. L’insensé dit dans son cœur : « Il n’y a pas de Dieu. » Ils ont agi de façon corrompue, ils ont commis des actes abominables ; il n’y a personne qui fasse le bien.
fr.B: Au chef de chœur. De David. Les insensés se disent : « Il n’y a pas de Dieu. » Ils sont pourris jusqu’au fond ; ce qu’ils font est détestable. Pas un seul ne fait le bien.
fr.R: Pour le chef des musiciens. De David. Les gens insensés pensent : « Il n’y a pas de Dieu. » Ils sont mauvais, et ils font des choses horribles. Aucun d’eux ne fait ce qui est bien.

sw.L: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya. Ya Daudi. \q Mpumbavu anasema moyoni mwake, "Hakuna Mungu." \q Wametenda kwa upotovu, wametenda matendo ya machukizo; \q hakuna mmoja anayetenda mema.
sw.B: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya. Ya Daudi. \q Wapumbavu hujiambia, "Hakuna Mungu." Wameoza kabisa; \q wanayoyatenda ni ya kuchukiza. \q Hakuna hata mmoja wao anayetenda mema.
sw.R: Kwa kiongozi wa waimbaji. Ya Daudi. \q Watu wapumbavu hufikiri, "Hakuna Mungu." \q Wao ni waovu, nao hutenda mambo mabaya sana. \q Hakuna hata mmoja wao anayefanya yaliyo mema.

es.L: Al director del coro. De David. El necio dice en su corazón: «No hay Dios». Han actuado con corrupción, han cometido actos abominables; no hay quien practique el bien.
es.B: Al director del coro. De David. Los necios se dicen a sí mismos: «No hay Dios». Están podridos de arriba abajo; lo que hacen es detestable. Ninguno de ellos hace el bien.
es.R: Para el director de la música. De David. Las personas necias piensan: «No hay Dios». Son malas y hacen cosas terribles. Ninguna de ellas hace lo que es bueno.

vi.L: Cho người chỉ huy [ban nhạc]. Của Đa-vít. \q Kẻ ngu dại nói trong lòng: "Không có Đức Chúa Trời." \q Chúng đã hành động bại hoại, chúng đã làm những việc ghê tởm; \q không có ai làm điều lành.
vi.B: Cho nhạc trưởng. Của Đa-vít. \q Kẻ ngu dại tự nhủ: "Không có Đức Chúa Trời." Chúng hư hoại tận gốc; \q việc chúng làm thật ghê tởm. \q Chẳng một ai trong chúng làm điều lành.
vi.R: Cho người hướng dẫn ban nhạc. Của Đa-vít. \q Người ngu dại nghĩ: "Không có Đức Chúa Trời." \q Chúng gian ác và làm những điều kinh khủng. \q Không một ai trong chúng làm điều tốt.

ko.L: 지휘자를 위하여. 다윗의 [시]. \q 어리석은 자가 그의 마음속으로 "하나님은 없다" 하고 말한다. \q 그들은 타락하였고, 가증한 일을 저질렀으니, \q 선을 행하는 자가 없다.
ko.B: 음악 지휘자를 위하여. 다윗의 시. \q 어리석은 자들은 "하나님은 없다" 하고 속으로 말한다. \q 그들은 속속들이 썩었고, 그들이 하는 일은 역겹다. \q 선을 행하는 자가 하나도 없다.
ko.R: 찬양 인도자를 위해 다윗이 지은 노래. \q 어리석은 사람들은 "하나님은 없다" 하고 생각한다. \q 그들은 악하고 끔찍한 일을 한다. \q 그들 가운데 선한 일을 하는 사람은 아무도 없다.

pt.L: Para o regente. De Davi. O insensato diz no seu coração: "Não há Deus." Agiram de modo corrupto, cometeram atos abomináveis; não há ninguém que pratique o bem.
pt.B: Para o mestre de música. De Davi. Os insensatos dizem a si mesmos: "Deus não existe." Estão podres por inteiro; o que fazem é detestável. Ninguém faz o que é bom.
pt.R: Para quem dirige a música. De Davi. As pessoas sem juízo pensam: "Deus não existe." Elas são más e fazem coisas terríveis. Nenhuma delas faz o que é bom.

am.L: ለመዘምራን አለቃ፤ የዳዊት። \q ባለጌ በልቡ፦ «አምላክ የለም» ይላል። ተበላሹ፤ \q አስጸያፊ ሥራን ሠሩ፤ \q መልካምን የሚያደርግ የለም።
am.B: ለመዘምራን አለቃ። የዳዊት። \q ባለጌዎች «አምላክ የለም» ብለው ለራሳቸው ይናገራሉ። ፈጽመው ተበላሽተዋል፤ \q የሚያደርጉትም አስጸያፊ ነው። \q ከእነርሱ መልካም የሚያደርግ አንድ እንኳ የለም።
am.R: ለመዘምራን አለቃ። ዳዊት የዘመረው። \q ባለጌ ሰዎች «አምላክ የለም» ብለው ያስባሉ። ክፉዎች ናቸው፤ \q አሰቃቂ ነገሮችንም ያደርጋሉ። \q ከእነርሱ መልካም የሚያደርግ የለም።

hi.L: संगीत-निर्देशक के लिए। दाऊद का। मूर्ख अपने मन में कहता है, "कोई परमेश्वर नहीं।" उन्होंने भ्रष्ट काम किए हैं, उन्होंने घिनौने काम किए हैं; कोई भलाई करनेवाला नहीं।
hi.B: संगीत-निर्देशक के लिए। दाऊद का। मूर्ख अपने आप से कहते हैं, "कोई परमेश्वर नहीं है।" वे पूरी तरह बिगड़ चुके हैं; उनके काम घिनौने हैं। उनमें से कोई भलाई नहीं करता।
hi.R: गायक-मंडली के अगुवे के लिए। दाऊद का लिखा हुआ। मूर्ख लोग सोचते हैं, "परमेश्वर है ही नहीं।" वे दुष्ट हैं, और भयानक काम करते हैं। उनमें से कोई भी भलाई नहीं करता।

ru.L: Руководителю хора. Давида. Говорит безумец в сердце своём: «Нет Бога.» Они развращены, совершили мерзкие дела; нет делающего добро.
ru.B: Руководителю хора. Давида. Безумцы говорят себе: «Бога нет.» Они прогнили насквозь, их дела отвратительны. Ни один из них не делает добра.
ru.R: Для руководителя музыкантов. Написал Давид. Глупые люди думают: «Бога нет.» Они злые и делают ужасные вещи. Никто из них не делает добра.

ja.L: 指揮する者のために。ダビデによる。愚か者は心の中で言う。「神はいない。」彼らは堕落し、忌まわしいわざを行った。善を行う者はいない。
ja.B: 音楽を導く者のために。ダビデによる。愚かな者たちは、心の中で「神はいない」と言う。彼らは根まで腐り、その行いは忌まわしい。善を行う者は一人もいない。
ja.R: 音楽を導く人のために。ダビデによる。愚かな人たちは、「神はいない」と思っている。彼らは悪く、ひどいことをする。彼らの中に、良いことをする人はいない。

uk.L: Для диригента. Давидів. Безумний каже у своєму серці: «Немає Бога.» Вони зіпсувалися, вони чинять огидні діла; немає того, хто чинить добро.
uk.B: Для диригента хору. Давидів. Безумні кажуть собі: «Немає Бога.» Вони зіпсовані наскрізь, їхні вчинки огидні. Жоден із них не чинить добра.
uk.R: Для того, хто керує співом. Давидова пісня. Нерозумні люди думають: «Бога немає.» Вони злі й роблять жахливі речі. Жоден із них не робить добра.

decisions.choice: The title shares verse 1
decisions.reason: This psalm's title is short and the Hebrew counts it together with the first line as verse 1, so here the verse numbers are the same as in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: the fool: one who lives without regard for God
decisions.reason: The fool (naval) is not someone slow of mind but someone morally senseless, who acts as if God does not matter; Nabal, whose name is this word, is the example (1 Samuel 25:25).

decisions.choice: There is no God: living as if God will not act
decisions.reason: To say something "in the heart" is to think it. The fool is not arguing about whether God exists but living as if he will never see or judge, like the wicked of 10:4.

decisions.choice: Psalm 53 and Romans 3
decisions.reason: Psalm 53 is almost the same psalm, with "God" in place of "the LORD" and a different verse 6. Paul quotes verses 1-3 in Romans 3:10-12 to show that all people are under sin.

decisions.choice: Fools ... they (B); Foolish people (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew describes one figure ("he", "his") who stands for everyone who acts this way. Balanced and Readable make the portrait plural, as Psalm 10 does with "the wicked", which includes men and women alike; Literal keeps the Hebrew singular.

decisions.choice: "l'insensé" (Literal), "les insensés" (Balanced), "les gens insensés" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The fool (nabal) is one who lives without regard for God (m2), not someone mentally ill or slow. "Insensé" says a life without sense, the word French uses for the fool in Proverbs too.

decisions.choice: "mpumbavu" for the fool (nabal)
decisions.reason: The nabal is not a person short of brains but one who lives without regard for God (m2). "Mpumbavu" is the Swahili word for a fool in this moral sense, the same word used for the fool in Proverbs; "mjinga" there names the naive.

decisions.choice: el necio (L); los necios (B); las personas necias (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew naval is a person who lives without regard for God, not someone slow of mind. Spanish says "necio", the word used for the fool in Proverbs; Balanced and Readable make it plural, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "kẻ ngu dại" (L, B); "người ngu dại" (R)
decisions.reason: The fool here is not slow of mind but lives without regard for God (see the meaning decision). The terms note's words for the fool of Proverbs are used, so the two books agree.

decisions.choice: "어리석은 자" (L, B), "어리석은 사람" (R) for the fool (nabal)
alternatives: 미련한 자 (the word used for kesil in Proverbs)
decisions.reason: The fool here is one who lives without regard for God (meaning decision m2), a moral more than a mental failing. "어리석은" is the common Korean word for such folly; "미련한 자" stays for the Proverbs word kesil, so the two Hebrew words are not merged.

decisions.choice: não há ninguém que pratique o bem (L); Ninguém faz o que é bom (B); Nenhuma delas faz o que é bom (R)
alternatives: não há quem faça o bem
decisions.reason: Paul quotes this line in Romans 3:12 (m4); Literal and Balanced use the Portuguese of Romans 3:12 at the same level, and Readable keeps its words while following the English "None of them". Psalm 53:1 should reuse this verse.

decisions.choice: o insensato (L); os insensatos (B); as pessoas sem juízo (R)
decisions.reason: The fool here is morally senseless, not slow of mind (m2); "insensato" says that, where "tolo" suggests silliness.

decisions.choice: the fool (naval) as "ባለጌ", the terms-list word for naval; «አምላክ የለም» as 10:4
decisions.reason: The naval is morally base, one who lives without regard for God (meaning decision m2), not merely slow-witted; the terms list gives "ባለጌ" so that the three Hebrew words for "fool" stay apart. Psalm 53:2 repeats the verse.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of this psalm.
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; pronouns for God are written plainly.

decisions.choice: "कोई भलाई करनेवाला नहीं" (L), "कोई भलाई नहीं करता" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Romans 3:10-12 quotes verses 1-3 (m4). Where the Hebrew says what Romans 3:12 says, the wording is the Hindi of Romans 3:12 at each level. The psalm is set beside Psalm 53, which repeats it.

decisions.choice: "दाऊद का" (L, B); "दाऊद का लिखा हुआ" (R)
decisions.reason: The title says only "of David". Literal and Balanced keep the short form; Readable says "by David" in an everyday phrase, as the English Readable does. This is the form of "Of David" in every title of Psalms.

decisions.choice: "безумец" (L), "безумцы" (B); "глупые люди" (R)
decisions.reason: The naval is morally senseless, not slow of mind (m2); "безумец" says a man who has lost his sense of right, where "глупец" (kept for kesil in Proverbs) would say only foolish. Readable says it in plain words, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "нет делающего добро" (L); "не делает добра" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The same words as Romans 3:12 in this translation, which quotes verses 1-3 (m4); verse 3 repeats them.

decisions.choice: nabal "愚か者" (L), "愚かな者たち" (B), "愚かな人たち" (R)
decisions.reason: m2: the fool lives without regard for God; Balanced and Readable make him plural with the English.

decisions.choice: "善を行う者はいない" (L, B), "良いことをする人はいない" (R), the words of ROM 3:12 in the Open Word Bible Japanese
decisions.reason: m4: Romans 3 quotes this line; the Hebrew and the Greek agree here, so the Japanese matches the New Testament at each level.

decisions.choice: "безумний" (L, B), "нерозумні люди" (R) for the fool, through the book
decisions.reason: The fool of the Psalms is one who lives as if God were not there, not one who lacks wit; "безумний" carries that moral sense, and Readable says it plainly.

source.text: יְֽהוָ֗ה מִשָּׁמַיִם֮ הִשְׁקִ֪יף עַֽל־בְּנֵי־אָ֫דָ֥ם לִ֭רְאוֹת הֲיֵ֣שׁ מַשְׂכִּ֑יל דֹּ֝רֵשׁ אֶת־אֱלֹהִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH from heaven looks down on [the] children of man to see [whether] there is [one] who has insight, who seeks God.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} from heaven looks down on the {{gender:children of humankind|sons of men}} to see whether there is [anyone] who has insight, who seeks God.
en.B: From heaven {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} looks down on the human race to see whether anyone is wise, anyone who is looking for God.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} watches all people from heaven. He wants to see if anyone is wise and wants to know God.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, du haut des cieux, se penche sur les {{gender:enfants des humains|fils des hommes}} pour voir s’il y a [quelqu’un] qui comprenne, qui cherche Dieu.
fr.B: Du haut du ciel, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} regarde le genre humain pour voir si quelqu’un est sage, si quelqu’un cherche Dieu.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} observe tous les gens depuis le ciel. Il veut voir si quelqu’un est sage et désire connaître Dieu.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kutoka mbinguni anawachungulia wanadamu ili kuona kama yuko [mtu] mwenye akili, \q anayemtafuta Mungu.
sw.B: Kutoka mbinguni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anawatazama wanadamu wote ili aone kama yupo mwenye hekima, \q yeyote anayemtafuta Mungu.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anawatazama watu wote kutoka mbinguni. \q Anataka kuona kama yupo mtu mwenye hekima anayetaka kumjua Mungu.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} desde los cielos mira hacia abajo sobre {{gender:los hijos de la humanidad|los hijos de los hombres}} para ver si hay [alguien] que tenga entendimiento, que busque a Dios.
es.B: Desde el cielo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} observa a la raza humana para ver si hay alguien sabio, alguien que busque a Dios.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} observa a toda la gente desde el cielo. Quiere ver si alguien es sabio y quiere conocer a Dios.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} từ trên trời nhìn xuống con cái loài người, để xem có ai sáng suốt, \q có ai tìm kiếm Đức Chúa Trời chăng.
vi.B: Từ trên trời, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nhìn xuống loài người, để xem có ai khôn ngoan, \q có ai đang tìm kiếm Đức Chúa Trời không.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} từ trên trời nhìn xem mọi người. \q Ngài muốn xem có ai khôn ngoan \q và muốn biết Đức Chúa Trời không.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하늘에서 {{gender:사람의 자녀들을|사람의 아들들을}} 굽어보시고, 깨닫는 자가 있는지, \q 하나님을 찾는 자가 있는지 보신다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하늘에서 사람들을 굽어보시며, 지혜로운 사람이 있는지, \q 하나님을 찾는 사람이 있는지 살피신다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하늘에서 모든 사람을 지켜보신다. \q 지혜로운 사람이 있는지, \q 하나님을 알고 싶어 하는 사람이 있는지 보고 싶어 하신다.

pt.L: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} olha dos céus para os {{gender:filhos da humanidade|filhos dos homens}}, para ver se há [alguém] que entenda, que busque a Deus.
pt.B: Dos céus {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} olha para a humanidade, para ver se há alguém que entenda, alguém que busque a Deus.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} observa todas as pessoas lá do céu. Ele quer ver se alguém é sábio e procura a Deus.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከሰማይ ወደ ሰው ልጆች ይመለከታል፤ የሚያስተውል፣ እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈልግ ይኖር \q እንደ ሆነ ለማየት።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጠቢብ ሰው፣ እግዚአብሔርንም የሚፈልግ ሰው ይገኝ እንደ ሆነ ለማየት ከሰማይ ወደ ሰው \q ዘር ሁሉ ይመለከታል።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከሰማይ ሆኖ ሰዎችን ሁሉ ይመለከታል። \q ጥበበኛ የሆነና እግዚአብሔርን ማወቅ የሚፈልግ ሰው ይኖር እንደ ሆነ ለማየት ይፈልጋል።

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} स्वर्ग से {{gender:मनुष्य की सन्तान|मनुष्य के पुत्रों}} पर नीचे दृष्टि करते हैं, यह देखने के लिए कि क्या कोई समझनेवाला है, कोई परमेश्वर को खोजनेवाला।
hi.B: स्वर्ग से {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} मानवजाति पर नीचे दृष्टि करते हैं, यह देखने के लिए कि क्या कोई बुद्धिमान है, कोई जो परमेश्वर को खोजता हो।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} स्वर्ग से सब लोगों को देखते हैं। वे देखना चाहते हैं कि क्या कोई समझदार है, जो परमेश्वर को जानना चाहता हो।

ru.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} с небес смотрит вниз на {{gender:детей человеческих|сынов человеческих}}, чтобы увидеть, есть ли [кто-нибудь] понимающий, ищущий Бога.
ru.B: С небес {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} смотрит на род человеческий, чтобы увидеть, есть ли кто-нибудь разумный, кто ищет Бога.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} с небес смотрит на всех людей. Он хочет увидеть, есть ли хоть кто-то мудрый, кто хочет знать Бога.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は天から人の子らを見下ろされる。悟る者がいるか、神を探し求める者がいるかを見るために。
ja.B: 天から{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は人々を見下ろされる。悟る者がいるか、神を求める者がいるかを見ようとして。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、天からすべての人を見ておられる。わかる人がいるか、神を知りたいと思う人がいるかを、見ようとしておられる。

uk.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} з неба дивиться на {{gender:дітей людських|синів людських}}, щоб побачити, чи є [хтось], хто розуміє, хто шукає Бога.
uk.B: З неба {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} дивиться на людський рід, щоб побачити, чи є хтось мудрий, хтось, хто шукає Бога.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} дивиться з неба на всіх людей. Він хоче побачити, чи є хтось мудрий, хто прагне пізнати Бога.

decisions.choice: the LORD looks down to see: as before the flood and at Babel
decisions.reason: The LORD sees the earth before the flood (Genesis 6:5, 12) and comes down to see the tower of Babel (Genesis 11:5). Here too he looks before he judges.

decisions.choice: who has insight: who acts wisely
decisions.reason: The word (maskil) is used of someone who understands and so acts rightly; here it is joined to seeking God.

decisions.choice: who seeks God: who turns to God
decisions.reason: As in 9:11.

decisions.choice: children of humankind, with "sons of men" as the alternative
decisions.reason: As in 11:4.

decisions.choice: wants to know God
decisions.reason: Readable says what seeking God means (m3).

decisions.choice: que entenda, que busque a Deus (L, B); procura a Deus (R)
alternatives: que seja sensato, que procure a Deus
decisions.reason: Romans 3:11 quotes these words ("não há quem entenda; não há quem busque a Deus" at Literal, "Ninguém procura a Deus" at Readable); the psalm uses the same verbs at each level, and "entender" fits the Hebrew "has insight" (m2).

decisions.choice: "የሚያስተውል፣ እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈልግ" with the words of Romans 3:11 in the Amharic New Testament, kept inside the Hebrew question "to see whether there is one who ..."
alternatives: "የሚያስተውል የለም፤ እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈልግ የለም", as Romans 3:11
decisions.reason: Paul turns the psalm's question into a statement; the psalm keeps its own Hebrew shape and the New Testament words.

decisions.choice: "{{gender:मनुष्य की सन्तान|मनुष्य के पुत्रों}}"
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 7:14: "sons of man" means human beings, and Hindi has the same two wordings as the English setting.

decisions.choice: "समझनेवाला", "परमेश्वर को खोजनेवाला"
decisions.reason: The words of Romans 3:11 in this translation, which quotes this line; the psalm asks whether there is such a one, Romans draws the answer.

decisions.choice: "понимающий, ищущий Бога"
decisions.reason: Romans 3:11 quotes this line ("нет понимающего; нет ищущего Бога" in this translation); Literal keeps its participles where the Hebrew says the same.

decisions.choice: "悟る者" and "神を探し求める者" (L), "悟る者" and "神を求める者" (B), as ROM 3:11; Readable "わかる人" and "神を知りたいと思う人" with its English
decisions.reason: m2, m3: who acts wisely, who turns to God; Romans 3:11 draws on this verse, so Literal and Balanced use its words, and Readable follows r-en-2.

decisions.choice: "人の子ら" (L) with no gender span
decisions.reason: Japanese 人の子ら is not male, as at 11:4.

source.text: הַכֹּ֥ל סָר֮ יַחְדָּ֪ו נֶ֫אֱלָ֥חוּ אֵ֤ין עֹֽשֵׂה־ט֑וֹב אֵ֝֗ין גַּם־אֶחָֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: All has turned aside; together they have gone sour; there is none who does good, there is not even one.

en.L: All have turned aside; together they have gone sour; there is none who does good, not even one.
en.B: Everyone has left the road; all alike have gone bad. No one does good, not a single one.
en.R: Everyone has left the right way. All of them have become rotten. No one does what is good. Not even one person!

fr.L: Tous se sont détournés ; ensemble ils se sont gâtés ; il n’y a personne qui fasse le bien, pas même un seul.
fr.B: Tous ont quitté la route ; tous ensemble ils se sont corrompus. Personne ne fait le bien, pas un seul.
fr.R: Tout le monde a quitté le bon chemin. Ils sont tous devenus pourris. Personne ne fait ce qui est bien. Pas même une seule personne !

sw.L: Wote wamegeuka kando; kwa pamoja wamechachuka; \q hakuna mmoja anayetenda mema, \q hakuna hata mmoja.
sw.B: Kila mmoja ameiacha njia; wote kwa pamoja wameharibika. \q Hakuna anayetenda mema, \q hakuna hata mmoja.
sw.R: Kila mtu ameiacha njia iliyo sahihi. Wote wameoza. \q Hakuna anayefanya yaliyo mema. \q Hakuna hata mtu mmoja!

es.L: Todos se han desviado; a una se han echado a perder; no hay quien haga el bien, ni siquiera uno.
es.B: Todos se han salido del camino; todos por igual se han corrompido. Nadie hace el bien, ni uno solo.
es.R: Todos se han apartado del buen camino. Todos se han vuelto malos. Nadie hace lo que es bueno. ¡Ni una sola persona!

vi.L: Tất cả đã đi lệch; cùng nhau chúng đã trở nên hư thối; \q không có ai làm điều lành, \q dù một người cũng không.
vi.B: Mọi người đều đã lìa bỏ đường ngay; tất cả đều hư hỏng như nhau. \q Không ai làm điều lành, \q dù chỉ một người cũng không.
vi.R: Mọi người đều đã bỏ con đường đúng. Tất cả đều đã trở nên hư hỏng. \q Không ai làm điều tốt. \q Dù chỉ một người cũng không!

ko.L: 모두가 곁길로 빠졌고, 함께 썩어 버렸으니, \q 선을 행하는 자가 없다, \q 하나도 없다.
ko.B: 모두가 길에서 벗어났고, 다 함께 썩어 버렸다. \q 선을 행하는 사람이 없다. \q 단 한 사람도 없다.
ko.R: 모든 사람이 바른길에서 벗어났다. 모두 썩어 버렸다. \q 선한 일을 하는 사람이 없다. \q 단 한 사람도 없다!

pt.L: Todos se desviaram; juntos se estragaram; não há ninguém que pratique o bem, não há nem mesmo um.
pt.B: Todos se afastaram do caminho; todos juntos se estragaram. Ninguém faz o que é bom, nem um só.
pt.R: Todos se afastaram do caminho certo. Todos eles se estragaram. Ninguém faz o que é bom. Nem mesmo uma pessoa!

am.L: ሁሉ ከመንገድ ወጡ፤ በአንድነት ተበላሹ፤ \q መልካምን የሚያደርግ የለም፤ \q አንድ እንኳ የለም።
am.B: ሁሉም ከመንገድ ዘወር አሉ፤ ሁሉም በአንድነት ተበላሹ። \q መልካም የሚያደርግ የለም፤ \q አንድ ብቻ እንኳ የለም።
am.R: ሁሉም ከትክክለኛው መንገድ ዘወር አሉ። ሁሉም ተበላሹ። \q መልካም የሚያደርግ የለም፤ \q አንድ ሰው እንኳ የለም!

hi.L: सब भटक गए हैं, सब के सब बिगड़ गए हैं; कोई भलाई करनेवाला नहीं, एक भी नहीं।
hi.B: सब भटक गए हैं; सब मिलकर बिगड़ गए हैं। कोई भला काम नहीं करता, एक भी नहीं।
hi.R: सब लोग सही मार्ग से भटक गए हैं। वे सब बिगड़ चुके हैं। कोई भलाई नहीं करता, एक व्यक्ति भी नहीं!

ru.L: Все уклонились; вместе испортились; нет делающего добро, нет ни одного.
ru.B: Все отвернулись; все вместе испортились. Никто не делает добра, нет ни одного.
ru.R: Все они отвернулись от Бога. Все они стали гнилыми. Никто не делает добра, нет ни одного человека!

ja.L: すべての者がそれて行き、共に腐ってしまった。善を行う者はいない、一人もいない。
ja.B: 皆、道をそれ、ともに腐ってしまった。善を行う者はいない。ただの一人もいない。
ja.R: みんな、正しい道から離れてしまった。みんな、腐ってしまった。良いことをする人はいない。一人もいない！

uk.L: Усі звернули; разом вони зіпсувалися; немає того, хто чинить добро, немає жодного.
uk.B: Усі зійшли з дороги, усі разом зіпсувалися. Ніхто не чинить добра, ані жоден.
uk.R: Усі зійшли з правильної дороги. Усі вони стали гнилими. Ніхто не робить добра. Жодна людина!

decisions.choice: gone sour: become rotten
decisions.reason: The verb ('alach) is used of what has spoiled and become foul (Job 15:16). People have gone bad like spoiled food.

decisions.choice: turned aside: left the right way
decisions.reason: To turn aside (sur) is to leave the way God has set (Exodus 32:8).

decisions.choice: not even one: the end of the verse
decisions.reason: Some manuscripts of the ancient Greek translation add several lines here, the lines that Paul quotes after this verse in Romans 3:13-18. They are not in the Hebrew text.

decisions.choice: the wording of Romans 3:12 where the Hebrew is the same
decisions.reason: Paul quotes this verse in Romans 3:12 ("Todos se desviaram ... não há ninguém que pratique o bem, não há nem mesmo um" at Literal, "nem um só" at Balanced, "nem mesmo uma pessoa" at Readable). The psalm keeps those words but says "se estragaram" for the Hebrew "gone sour" (m1), where Paul's Greek has "become useless".

decisions.choice: The wording of Romans 3:12 in the Amharic New Testament ("ሁሉ ከመንገድ ወጡ ... መልካምን የሚያደርግ የለም፤ አንድ እንኳ የለም"), with "በአንድነት ተበላሹ" (together they have gone bad) for the Hebrew
decisions.reason: The Greek "became worthless" stands for the Hebrew "gone sour" (meaning decision m1); the rest agrees, so it keeps the New Testament words. Psalm 53:4 repeats the verse with "turned back" for "turned aside".

decisions.choice: "बिगड़ गए हैं" (gone sour, rotten)
alternatives: "निकम्मे बन गए" (L), "बेकार हो गए हैं" (B, R), as Romans 3:12
decisions.reason: The rest of the verse keeps the wording of Romans 3:12 at each level. Romans follows the Greek Old Testament, "they have become worthless"; the Hebrew says they have gone sour, like spoiled milk (m1), so the psalm says "बिगड़ गए".

decisions.choice: the wording of Romans 3:12 except for "gone sour"
decisions.reason: Paul quotes this verse in Romans 3:12, and where the Hebrew says the same the Psalm keeps that wording at each level ("Все уклонились", "Все отвернулись", "нет ни одного"). Romans follows the Greek "have become worthless"; the Hebrew says the people have gone sour like spoiled food (m1), so the Psalm has "испортились" (L, B) and "стали гнилыми" (R).

decisions.choice: ROM 3:12's Japanese at each level for "turned aside" and "none who does good, not even one", but "腐ってしまった" for ne'elachu, not "役に立たない者となった"
decisions.reason: m1: the Hebrew says gone sour, rotten, where the Greek says become useless; the Japanese follows the New Testament only where the two agree.

source.text: הֲלֹ֥א יָדְעוּ֮ כָּל־פֹּ֪עֲלֵ֫י אָ֥וֶן אֹכְלֵ֣י עַ֭מִּי אָ֣כְלוּ לֶ֑חֶם יְ֝הוָ֗ה לֹ֣א קָרָֽאוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Do they not know, all workers of wickedness, eaters of my people [who] eat bread? YHWH they do not call on.

en.L: Do they not know, all workers of wickedness, who eat up {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people [as] they eat bread? On {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} they do not call.
en.B: Have they learned nothing, all these evildoers? They devour {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people as if they were eating bread, and they never call on {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Do these evil people understand nothing? They destroy {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people as easily as they eat a meal. They never pray to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

fr.L: Ne savent-ils pas, tous ceux qui pratiquent la méchanceté, eux qui dévorent {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple [comme] ils mangent du pain ? {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, ils ne l’invoquent pas.
fr.B: N’ont-ils rien appris, tous ces malfaiteurs ? Ils dévorent {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple comme on mange du pain, et jamais ils n’invoquent {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Ces méchants ne comprennent-ils donc rien ? Ils détruisent {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple aussi facilement qu’ils prennent un repas. Jamais ils ne prient {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Je, hawajui, wote watendao uovu, \q wanaowala watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} [kama] wanavyokula mkate? \q Hawamwiti {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Je, hawajajifunza lolote, watenda maovu hawa wote? \q Wanawameza watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} kama wanaokula mkate, \q wala hawamwiti {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kamwe.
sw.R: Je, watu hawa waovu hawaelewi chochote? \q Wanawaangamiza watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} kwa urahisi kama wanavyokula chakula. \q Hawamwombi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kamwe.

es.L: ¿No saben, todos los que hacen maldad, que devoran a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo [como] comen pan? No invocan {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: ¿No han aprendido nada todos estos malhechores? Devoran a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo como quien come pan, y nunca invocan {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.R: ¿No entienden nada estas personas malvadas? Destruyen a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo tan fácilmente como quien se come un pan. Nunca le oran {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.

vi.L: Chẳng lẽ chúng không biết sao, tất cả những kẻ làm điều gian ác, \q là những kẻ ăn nuốt dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [như] chúng ăn bánh? \q Chúng không kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Chẳng lẽ chúng không hiểu gì sao, tất cả những kẻ làm ác ấy? \q Chúng ăn nuốt dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} như ăn bánh, \q và chẳng bao giờ kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Những kẻ ác này không hiểu gì sao? \q Chúng tiêu diệt dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} dễ như ăn một bữa cơm. \q Chúng chẳng bao giờ cầu nguyện với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 악을 행하는 자들은 모두 알지 못하느냐? \q 그들은 빵을 먹듯 내 백성을 먹어 치우고, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 부르지 않는다.
ko.B: 이 악을 행하는 자들은 아무것도 깨닫지 못했느냐? \q 그들은 빵을 먹듯이 내 백성을 삼키고, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 결코 부르지 않는다.
ko.R: 이 악한 사람들은 아무것도 모르느냐? \q 그들은 밥 먹듯이 쉽게 내 백성을 망가뜨린다. \q 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 결코 기도하지 않는다.

pt.L: Não sabem, todos os que praticam a iniquidade, que devoram o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo [como] comem pão? {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} eles não invocam.
pt.B: Será que não aprenderam nada, todos esses malfeitores? Devoram o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo como quem come pão, e nunca invocam {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: Essas pessoas más não entendem nada? Elas destroem o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo com a mesma facilidade com que fazem uma refeição. Nunca oram {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.

am.L: ዓመፅን የሚሠሩ ሁሉ አያውቁምን? \q እንጀራ እንደሚበሉ ሕዝቤን ይበላሉ፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} አይጠሩም።
am.B: እነዚህ ክፉ አድራጊዎች ሁሉ ምንም አልተማሩምን? \q እንጀራ እንደሚበሉ ሕዝቤን ይውጣሉ፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ከቶ አይጠሩም።
am.R: እነዚህ ክፉ ሰዎች ምንም አያስተውሉምን? \q ምግብ እንደሚበሉ በቀላሉ ሕዝቤን ያጠፋሉ። \q ወደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከቶ አይጸልዩም።

hi.L: क्या वे नहीं जानते, सब दुष्टता के काम करनेवाले, जो मेरी प्रजा को [ऐसे] खा जाते हैं [जैसे] रोटी खाते हैं? {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को वे नहीं पुकारते।
hi.B: क्या इन कुकर्मियों ने कुछ नहीं सीखा? वे मेरी प्रजा को ऐसे निगल जाते हैं मानो रोटी खा रहे हों, और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को कभी नहीं पुकारते।
hi.R: क्या ये दुष्ट लोग कुछ भी नहीं समझते? वे मेरी प्रजा को ऐसे नष्ट करते हैं जैसे कोई आसानी से खाना खा लेता है। वे कभी {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से प्रार्थना नहीं करते।

ru.L: Неужели не знают все творящие беззаконие, поедающие {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} народ, [как] едят хлеб? {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} они не призывают.
ru.B: Неужели ничему не научились все эти злодеи? Они пожирают {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} народ, словно едят хлеб, и никогда не призывают {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Неужели эти злые люди ничего не понимают? Они губят {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} народ так же легко, как садятся за обед. Они никогда не молятся {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}.

ja.L: 悪を行う者たちはみな、知らないのか？パンを食べるように、わたしの民を食らう者たちは。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を、彼らは呼び求めない。
ja.B: この悪を行う者たちはみな、何も学ばなかったのか？彼らは、パンを食べるかのように、わたしの民を食い尽くし、決して{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を呼び求めない。
ja.R: この悪いことをする人たちは、何もわからないのか？食事でもするように、たやすくわたしの民を滅ぼしている。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に祈ろうとは、決してしない。

uk.L: Хіба не знають усі, хто чинить нечестя, що поїдають {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} народ, [як] їдять хліб? {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} вони не кличуть.
uk.B: Невже нічого не навчилися всі ці лиходії? Вони пожирають {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} народ, ніби їдять хліб, і ніколи не кличуть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.
uk.R: Невже ці злі люди нічого не розуміють? Вони нищать {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} народ так легко, як їдять обід. Вони ніколи не моляться {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}.

decisions.choice: my people: God's people, God speaking
decisions.reason: "My people" is most naturally God's own word for Israel, as when he speaks in 50:7 and 81:9, here spoken in the middle of the psalmist's words. The psalmist could be speaking of his own people, but they are the same people.

decisions.choice: eat my people as they eat bread: destroy them without a thought
decisions.reason: The wicked consume the poor as casually as they sit down to a meal (Micah 3:3).

decisions.choice: workers of wickedness: evildoers
decisions.reason: As in 5:6.

decisions.choice: call on the LORD: pray to him
decisions.reason: To call on the LORD is to turn to him in prayer and worship (Genesis 4:26).

decisions.choice: "dân Ta" (my people), God speaking, with the deity_pronoun setting
decisions.reason: God himself speaks in this line (see the meaning decision), so "my" is his "Ta", as when he speaks in Psalm 2; "dân Ngài" would hide the change of voice.

decisions.choice: "내 백성" (my people) in 해라체, God's own voice
decisions.reason: The words "my people" show that God is speaking (meaning decision m1); Korean gives him the 해라체 used for God's speech, while the psalmist names "the LORD" in the third person at the end of the verse, as the Hebrew does.

decisions.choice: "मेरी प्रजा", with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: God is the speaker of "my people" (m1). Devanagari has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Hindi and the text has no spans.

decisions.choice: "わたしの民": God speaks; no deity_pronoun span in Japanese
decisions.reason: m1: my people are God's people in God's own words; Japanese わたし needs no capital form.

decisions.choice: po'alei 'awen "悪を行う者たち" (L, B), "悪いことをする人たち" (R)
decisions.reason: The Psalter's form for the workers of wickedness (5:6, 6:9).

records.literal_gloss: There they dread [with] dread, for God [is] with [the] generation of [the] righteous.

en.L: There they have dreaded [with] dread, for God [is] with the generation of the righteous.
en.B: There they will be gripped by terror, because God is with the people who are righteous.
en.R: But then fear will take hold of them, because God is with the people who do what is right.

fr.L: Là, ils ont été saisis d’effroi, car Dieu [est] avec la génération des justes.
fr.B: Alors la terreur s’emparera d’eux, car Dieu est avec le peuple des justes.
fr.R: Mais alors la peur les saisira, parce que Dieu est avec les gens qui font ce qui est juste.

sw.L: Huko wameogopa [kwa] hofu kuu, \q kwa maana Mungu [yuko] pamoja na kizazi cha wenye haki.
sw.B: Huko watashikwa na hofu kuu, \q kwa sababu Mungu yuko pamoja na watu walio wenye haki.
sw.R: Lakini ndipo hofu itawashika, \q kwa sababu Mungu yuko pamoja na watu wanaotenda haki.

es.L: Allí temblaron de espanto, porque Dios [está] con la generación de los justos.
es.B: Allí los dominará el terror, porque Dios está con la gente justa.
es.R: Pero entonces el miedo se apoderará de ellos, porque Dios está con los que hacen lo correcto.

vi.L: Tại đó chúng đã kinh hãi [với] nỗi kinh hãi, \q vì Đức Chúa Trời [ở] với dòng dõi người công chính.
vi.B: Tại đó chúng sẽ bị nỗi kinh hoàng bao trùm, \q vì Đức Chúa Trời ở với những người công chính.
vi.R: Nhưng rồi nỗi sợ hãi sẽ chụp lấy chúng, \q vì Đức Chúa Trời ở với những người làm điều đúng.

ko.L: 거기서 그들이 두려움으로 두려워하였으니, \q 하나님께서 의인의 세대와 함께 계시기 때문이다.
ko.B: 거기서 그들은 공포에 사로잡힐 것이다. \q 하나님께서 의로운 사람들과 함께 계시기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그러나 그때 그들은 두려움에 사로잡힐 것이다. \q 하나님께서 바르게 사는 사람들과 함께 계시기 때문이다.

pt.L: Ali temeram [com] temor, porque Deus [está] com a geração do justo.
pt.B: Ali eles serão tomados de terror, porque Deus está com o povo dos justos.
pt.R: Mas então o medo vai tomar conta deles, porque Deus está com as pessoas que fazem o que é certo.

am.L: በዚያ ታላቅ ፍርሃትን ፈሩ፤ \q እግዚአብሔር ከጻድቃን ትውልድ ጋር ነውና።
am.B: በዚያን ጊዜ ብርቱ ድንጋጤ ይይዛቸዋል፤ \q እግዚአብሔር ከጻድቃን ሕዝብ ጋር ነውና።
am.R: ከዚያ ግን ፍርሃት ይይዛቸዋል፤ \q እግዚአብሔር ትክክል የሆነውን ከሚያደርጉ ሰዎች ጋር ነውና።

hi.L: वहाँ वे भय से भयभीत हुए, क्योंकि परमेश्वर धर्मियों की पीढ़ी के साथ [हैं]।
hi.B: वहाँ उन पर आतंक छा जाएगा, क्योंकि परमेश्वर धर्मी लोगों के साथ हैं।
hi.R: पर तब उन्हें डर जकड़ लेगा, क्योंकि परमेश्वर उन लोगों के साथ हैं जो सही काम करते हैं।

ru.L: Там они ужаснулись ужасом, потому что Бог — с родом праведных.
ru.B: Там их охватит ужас, потому что Бог — с теми, кто праведен.
ru.R: Но тогда их охватит страх, потому что Бог — с людьми, которые поступают правильно.

ja.L: そこで、彼らは恐れおののいた。神は正しい者の世代と共におられるからだ。
ja.B: そのとき、彼らは恐怖に捕らえられる。神が正しい人たちと共におられるからだ。
ja.R: しかし、そのとき、彼らは恐れに捕らえられる。神が、正しいことをする人たちと共におられるからだ。

uk.L: Там вони затремтіли [від] жаху, бо Бог — з родом праведних.
uk.B: Там їх охопить жах, бо Бог — з тими, хто праведний.
uk.R: Але тоді страх схопить їх, бо Бог — з людьми, які чинять правильно.

decisions.choice: There they dread: the moment God acts
decisions.reason: "There" points to a place or a moment: when God steps in, the evildoers who felt safe are struck with terror. The verb is in the past form, as often in prophecy, for what is certain to happen.

decisions.choice: the generation of the righteous: righteous people
decisions.reason: "Generation" here means a group or kind of people (12:8; 24:6).

decisions.choice: Psalm 53 differs here
decisions.reason: The matching verse, 53:6, goes on differently: God scatters the bones of those who attack his people.

decisions.choice: "恐れおののいた" (L) for the doubled verb; "正しい者の世代" (L), "正しい人たち" (B, R)
decisions.reason: m1: the moment God acts; m2: the generation of the righteous means righteous people.

records.literal_gloss: [The] plan of [the] afflicted you would put to shame, but YHWH [is] his refuge.

en.L: The plan of the afflicted you would put to shame, but {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] his refuge.
en.B: You evildoers would make the hopes of the poor come to nothing, but {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is their shelter.
en.R: You evil people try to ruin the plans of poor people. But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} protects them.

fr.L: Le projet de l’humble, vous voudriez [le] couvrir de honte, mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] son refuge.
fr.B: Vous, les malfaiteurs, vous voudriez faire échouer les espoirs du pauvre, mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est son abri.
fr.R: Vous, les méchants, vous essayez de ruiner les projets des pauvres. Mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} les protège.

sw.L: Mpango wa mnyonge mngeuaibisha, \q lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] kimbilio lake.
sw.B: Ninyi watenda maovu mngetaka kuyafanya matumaini ya maskini yawe bure, \q lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni kimbilio lao.
sw.R: Ninyi watu waovu mnajaribu kuiharibu mipango ya maskini. \q Lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anawalinda.

es.L: El plan del afligido {{plural_you:ustedes avergonzarían|vosotros avergonzaríais}}, pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [es] su refugio.
es.B: {{plural_you:Ustedes, malhechores, quisieran|Vosotros, malhechores, quisierais}} hacer fracasar las esperanzas de los pobres, pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es su refugio.
es.R: {{plural_you:Ustedes, gente malvada, tratan|Vosotros, gente malvada, tratáis}} de arruinar los planes de los pobres. Pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} los protege.

vi.L: Mưu định của người khốn khổ, các người muốn làm cho hổ thẹn, \q nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là] nơi ẩn náu của người ấy.
vi.B: Hỡi những kẻ làm ác, các người muốn làm cho niềm hy vọng của người nghèo tan thành mây khói, \q nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là nơi trú ẩn của họ.
vi.R: Hỡi những kẻ ác, các người tìm cách phá hỏng kế hoạch của người nghèo. \q Nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} bảo vệ họ.

ko.L: 너희가 고난받는 사람의 계획을 부끄럽게 하려 하지만, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그의 피난처이시다.
ko.B: 악을 행하는 너희는 가난한 사람들의 소망을 꺾으려 하지만, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들의 피난처가 되신다.
ko.R: 악한 너희는 가난한 사람들의 계획을 망치려고 한다. \q 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들을 지켜 주신다.

pt.L: O plano do aflito vocês envergonhariam, mas {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} [é] o refúgio dele.
pt.B: Vocês, malfeitores, querem fazer fracassar as esperanças dos pobres, mas {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} é o abrigo deles.
pt.R: Vocês, gente má, tentam estragar os planos dos pobres. Mas {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} os protege.

am.L: እናንተ የድሃውን ምክር ታሳፍራላችሁ፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ግን መጠጊያው [ነው]።
am.B: እናንተ ክፉ አድራጊዎች የድሆችን ተስፋ ከንቱ ታደርጋላችሁ፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ግን መጠጊያቸው ነው።
am.R: እናንተ ክፉ ሰዎች የድሆችን ዕቅድ ለማበላሸት ትሞክራላችሁ። \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ግን ይጠብቃቸዋል።

hi.L: दीन की योजना को तुम लज्जित करोगे, पर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} उसके शरणस्थान [हैं]।
hi.B: हे कुकर्मियो, तुम ग़रीबों की आशाओं को मिट्टी में मिलाना चाहते हो, पर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} उनके शरणस्थान हैं।
hi.R: हे दुष्ट लोगो, तुम ग़रीबों की योजनाओं को बिगाड़ना चाहते हो। पर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} उनकी रक्षा करते हैं।

ru.L: Замысел угнетённого вы посрамили бы, но {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} — его прибежище.
ru.B: Вы, злодеи, хотели бы обратить в ничто надежды бедных, но {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} — их прибежище.
ru.R: Вы, злые люди, стараетесь разрушить планы бедных. Но {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} защищает их.

ja.L: 苦しむ者の計らいを、あなたがたは辱めようとする。しかし、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は彼の避け所だ。
ja.B: 悪を行う者たちよ、あなたがたは貧しい人たちの望みを打ち砕こうとする。しかし、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が彼らの避け所だ。
ja.R: 悪いことをする人たちよ、あなたがたは貧しい人たちの計画をつぶそうとする。しかし、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が彼らを守ってくださる。

uk.L: Задум пригнобленого ви осоромили б, але {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} — його притулок.
uk.B: Ви, лиходії, хотіли б перетворити на ніщо надії бідних, але {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} — їхній сховок.
uk.R: Ви, злі люди, намагаєтеся зруйнувати плани бідних. Але {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} захищає їх.

decisions.choice: you: the evildoers
decisions.reason: The psalmist turns and speaks to the evildoers of verse 4 directly.

decisions.choice: you would put to shame: you try to frustrate
decisions.reason: The verb is in the unfinished form and describes what the evildoers try to do. Their attempt fails, for the LORD shelters the poor.

decisions.choice: refuge: a place of shelter
decisions.reason: The word (machseh) comes from the verb "take refuge" (2:12).

decisions.choice: You evildoers (B); You evil people (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the people addressed (m1).

decisions.choice: the poor ... their (B); poor people ... them (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew describes one figure ("he", "his") who stands for everyone who acts this way. Balanced and Readable make the portrait plural, as Psalm 10 does with "the wicked", which includes men and women alike; Literal keeps the Hebrew singular.

decisions.choice: vocês
decisions.reason: The psalmist turns to the evildoers (m1), people addressed as a group, so "vocês"; "tu" is kept for God.

decisions.choice: "तुम" to the evildoers
decisions.reason: The psalmist turns to the evildoers (m1); as the poetry terms note settles, he speaks to people and to enemies with "तुम", keeping "तू" for God.

decisions.choice: "вы"

records.literal_gloss: Who will give from Zion [the] salvation of Israel! When returns YHWH [the] fortunes of his people, may Jacob rejoice, may Israel be glad.

en.L: Who will give from Zion the salvation of Israel! When {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} restores the fortunes of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people, let Jacob rejoice, let Israel be glad.
en.B: If only Zion would send Israel its rescue! When {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} turns back the fortunes of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people, let Jacob shout for joy and Israel be glad.
en.R: How I wish that help would come from Zion and save Israel! When {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} makes life good again for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people, the people of Jacob will shout for joy, and Israel will celebrate.

fr.L: Qui donnera de Sion le salut d’Israël ! Quand {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} rétablira le sort de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple, que Jacob se réjouisse, qu’Israël soit dans la joie !
fr.B: Ah, si Sion pouvait envoyer à Israël sa délivrance ! Quand {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} rétablira le sort de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple, que Jacob crie de joie et qu’Israël soit dans l’allégresse !
fr.R: Comme je souhaite que le secours vienne de Sion et sauve Israël ! Quand {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} rendra la vie belle à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple, le peuple de Jacob criera de joie et Israël fera la fête.

sw.L: Ni nani atakayetoa kutoka Sayuni wokovu wa Israeli! \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakaporejesha hali njema ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, \q Yakobo na ashangilie, Israeli na afurahi.
sw.B: Laiti Sayuni ingeleta wokovu kwa Israeli! \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakapowarudishia watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mema yao, \q Yakobo na apige kelele za furaha na Israeli afurahi.
sw.R: Natamani sana msaada uje kutoka Sayuni na kuwaokoa Israeli! \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakapoyafanya maisha ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kuwa mazuri tena, watu wa Yakobo watapiga kelele za furaha, \q na Israeli watasherehekea.

es.L: ¡Quién diera desde Sion la salvación de Israel! Cuando {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} restaure la suerte de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo, que se goce Jacob, que se alegre Israel.
es.B: ¡Ojalá viniera de Sion la salvación para Israel! Cuando {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} restaure la suerte de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo, que Jacob grite de alegría y que Israel se alegre.
es.R: ¡Cómo quisiera que la ayuda viniera de Sion y salvara a Israel! Cuando {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} haga que la vida vuelva a ser buena para {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo, el pueblo de Jacob gritará de alegría, e Israel hará fiesta.

vi.L: Ước gì từ Si-ôn sự cứu rỗi của Y-sơ-ra-ên đến! \q Khi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phục hồi vận mệnh của dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, nguyện Gia-cốp vui mừng, \q nguyện Y-sơ-ra-ên hớn hở.
vi.B: Ước gì sự giải cứu cho Y-sơ-ra-ên đến từ Si-ôn! \q Khi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đổi lại vận mệnh của dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q nguyện Gia-cốp reo mừng và Y-sơ-ra-ên hân hoan.
vi.R: Tôi mong biết bao sự giúp đỡ đến từ Si-ôn và cứu Y-sơ-ra-ên! \q Khi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm cho cuộc sống của dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tốt đẹp trở lại, \q con cháu Gia-cốp sẽ reo mừng, và Y-sơ-ra-ên sẽ hân hoan.

ko.L: 누가 시온에서 이스라엘의 구원을 주겠는가! \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 백성의 운명을 회복시키실 때, \q 야곱이 즐거워하고 이스라엘이 기뻐하기를!
ko.B: 시온에서 이스라엘의 구원이 오기만 한다면! \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 백성의 형편을 되돌려 주실 때, \q 야곱이 기뻐 외치고 이스라엘이 즐거워하기를 바란다.
ko.R: 시온에서 도움이 와서 이스라엘을 구원하면 얼마나 좋을까! \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 백성의 삶을 다시 좋게 해 주실 때, 야곱의 자손은 기뻐 외치고 \q 이스라엘은 크게 즐거워할 것이다.

pt.L: Quem dará de Sião a salvação de Israel! Quando {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} restaurar a sorte do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo, alegre-se Jacó, regozije-se Israel.
pt.B: Ah, se de Sião viesse o livramento de Israel! Quando {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} mudar a sorte do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo, que Jacó grite de alegria e Israel se alegre.
pt.R: Como eu queria que o socorro viesse de Sião e salvasse Israel! Quando {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tornar boa de novo a vida do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo, o povo de Jacó vai gritar de alegria, e Israel vai festejar.

am.L: ከጽዮን የእስራኤልን ማዳን ማን በሰጠ! \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የሕዝቡን ዕጣ ፈንታ በመለሰ ጊዜ ያዕቆብ ሐሤት ያድርግ፤ \q እስራኤል ደስ ይበለው።
am.B: ምነው የእስራኤል ማዳን ከጽዮን በመጣ! \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የሕዝቡን ዕጣ ፈንታ በሚመልስበት ጊዜ ያዕቆብ እልል ይበል፤ \q እስራኤልም ደስ ይበለው።
am.R: ምነው እስራኤልን የሚያድን ርዳታ ከጽዮን በመጣ! \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለሕዝቡ ሕይወትን እንደ ገና መልካም ሲያደርግ የያዕቆብ ዘሮች በደስታ እልል ይላሉ፤ \q እስራኤልም ደስ ይለዋል።

hi.L: कौन सिय्योन से इस्राएल का उद्धार देगा! जब {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपनी प्रजा की दशा फेरेंगे, तब याकूब मगन हो, इस्राएल आनंदित हो।
hi.B: काश, सिय्योन से इस्राएल का उद्धार आता! जब {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपनी प्रजा के दिन फेरेंगे, तब याकूब जयजयकार करे और इस्राएल आनंदित हो।
hi.R: कितना अच्छा हो कि सिय्योन से सहायता आए और इस्राएल को बचाए! जब {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपनी प्रजा के अच्छे दिन लौटा देंगे, तब याकूब के लोग आनंद से जयजयकार करेंगे, और इस्राएल उत्सव मनाएगा।

ru.L: Кто даст с Сиона спасение Израилю! Когда {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} вернёт благополучие своему народу, пусть ликует Иаков, пусть радуется Израиль.
ru.B: О, если бы с Сиона пришло спасение Израилю! Когда {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} повернёт к добру судьбу своего народа, пусть Иаков ликует и Израиль радуется.
ru.R: Как бы я хотел, чтобы с Сиона пришла помощь и спасла Израиль! Когда {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} снова сделает жизнь своего народа хорошей, народ Иакова будет ликовать, и Израиль будет праздновать.

ja.L: だれが、シオンからイスラエルの救いを与えてくれるだろうか！{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がご自分の民の繁栄を回復されるとき、ヤコブが楽しみ、イスラエルが喜ぶように。
ja.B: シオンから、イスラエルに救いが来ればよいのに！{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がご自分の民の繁栄を元に戻されるとき、ヤコブが喜び叫び、イスラエルが喜ぶように。
ja.R: シオンから助けが来て、イスラエルを救ってくれたら、どんなによいだろう！{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がご自分の民の生活をもう一度良くしてくださるとき、ヤコブの人々は喜び叫び、イスラエルは大喜びする。

uk.L: Хто дасть із Сіону спасіння Ізраїлеві! Коли {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} поверне долю свого народу, нехай радіє Яків, нехай веселиться Ізраїль.
uk.B: Якби ж то Сіон послав Ізраїлеві порятунок! Коли {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} змінить долю свого народу, нехай Яків співає від радості, а Ізраїль веселиться.
uk.R: Як я хочу, щоб допомога прийшла із Сіону й урятувала Ізраїль! Коли {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} знову зробить життя свого народу добрим, нащадки Якова співатимуть від радості, а Ізраїль святкуватиме.

decisions.choice: Who will give: if only
decisions.reason: "Who will give ...?" is the Hebrew way of expressing a wish (Deuteronomy 5:29).

decisions.choice: from Zion: from the place where God lives among his people
decisions.reason: Zion, the hill of Jerusalem where the ark stood, is where the LORD is said to live (2:6; 9:12); help for Israel comes from him there.

decisions.choice: restores the fortunes: brings back the good days
decisions.reason: The phrase (shuv shevut) was once read "turn back the captivity", but it is also used where no exile is in view (Job 42:10): God turns a people's ruin into blessing.

decisions.choice: let Jacob rejoice: a wish or a promise
decisions.reason: The verbs can be read as wishes or as statements about the future; Readable says what will happen, which comes to the same.

decisions.choice: restores the fortunes as "የሕዝቡን ዕጣ ፈንታ መለሰ" (L, B), "ሕይወትን እንደ ገና መልካም አደረገ" (R)
decisions.reason: The phrase means bringing back the good days (meaning decision m3), not only the return of exiles.
"Who will give" is the Hebrew way of saying "if only" (m1). Literal keeps the words, with an exclamation mark; Balanced and Readable use the Hindi forms of a wish.

decisions.choice: "своему народу", "своего народа", no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: The English has a span on "his people"; Russian refers back to the subject with the reflexive "свой", which takes no span.

decisions.choice: "だれが…与えてくれるだろうか！" (L) keeps the Hebrew idiom; "来ればよいのに" (B); "ヤコブが楽しみ…ように" (L, B) as a wish, plain future (R) as a promise
decisions.reason: m1: who will give means if only; m4: let Jacob rejoice can be a wish or a promise, and each level follows its English.
